root_cause.statement: Daily ranking continues to validate baseline, target and evidence fields without requiring a pre-existing immutable denominator item or proving that the implementation can add or reclassify that item in the selected metric numerator. Generic synthetic pilots therefore reach live behavior and predictably re-read at zero effect.

live_completion_actual_effect.common_reason: The bounded pilot did not add or reclassify a completed item in the immutable live-completion ledger.

smallest_safe_corrective_action: Before assigning any Trends task to a dashboard metric, require a stable pre-existing denominator_item_id from that metric's immutable ledger.
Name the exact existing item state and the implementation action that can transition it into the numerator under the unchanged formula.
Reject synthetic capability evidence that changes only a pilot-local fixture or endpoint while leaving the canonical ledger untouched.
If no causal item exists, emit NO_COMPATIBLE_METRIC and keep the task READY without consuming an implementation/deployment slot.

expected_effect.process: Stop predictable zero-effect assignments and reserve implementation capacity for a ledger-eligible product or operational outcome.
expected_effect.raw_target: The next accepted live-completion assignment is capable of moving the unchanged raw input from 1/4 to 2/4.
expected_effect.measurement: Compare the next accepted assignment cohort with the current 0/13 gain baseline and re-read the exact immutable metric after canonical production verification.
expected_effect.credit_policy: No score, completion or product credit until canonical ACTUAL_EFFECT proves the raw change.

acceptance: assignment contains denominator_item_id from an immutable source
eligibility evidence names current item state, target transition, user-visible or operational outcome and production route
ranking rejects tasks whose only measurable effect is pilot-local
terminal receipt re-reads the same immutable metric
zero delta remains EVALUATED_NO_EFFECT and releases or rebinds the task lock
